title: SolidCraft Render Material Quality Qualification Register
intent: Hard separation of published file integrity, visual fidelity, physical provenance and native application acceptance.

conditions.asset_validation: Successful PNG/glTF numeric integrity is not a visual approval
conditions.native_acceptance: Requires SolidCraft executable CPU/GPU/viewport and save-reopen
conditions.premium_visual: Requires reviewed comparisons with real-world photos/measurements, multi-light and camera conditions
conditions.physical: Never silently invent density, stiffness, strength, dielectric spectra or certification

high_priority_gaps: Procedural design specifications and approximation families intermixed with runnable assets
Physical reference coverage incomplete (345 candidate and 303 unresolved appearance records)
Growth rings overly regular and species-shape similarity
Finish-dependent roughness/clearcoat maps not fully exported
Finite patches not seam-free; wood grain is illustrative
Reflectance color/complex IOR not alloy-grade measured
Surface roughness anisotropy and oxides not calibrated in native renderer
Layer-height/source-specimen property mismatch must remain separated
Texture mip anisotropy/grazing angles not native accepted
Unmeasured transmission/volume properties and resin scattering
Printed strength depends on build/cure/orientation, cannot import generic model
Stone/clast distributions too procedural or not resolved in preview
Preview physical-height gradients omit mm-per-texel transform
No measured optical constants for PBR studies
41 elements scientifically reference-only, not plausible bulk specimens
Isotope/allotrope/temperature/purity not specified for automatic engineering use
